headline: "Confidence in the som needs to be increased". Central bank head on reducing dollarization in the economy
summary: Central bank head Timur Ishmetov said Uzbekistan plans to expand lending and savings in the national currency to reduce currency risks. He also set the goal of accelerating privatization of state banks, which hold 60.8% of banking-sector assets.
why: Central bank policy on currency use and bank ownership shapes lending conditions, exchange-rate risk and the investment climate in the economy.
original_headline: “So‘mga bo‘lgan ishonchni oshirish kerak”. Markaziy bank raisi iqtisodiyotda dollarlashuvni kamaytirish haqida
